product.name: Open Source Contributor Network India
product.tagline: Indian OSS contributors find projects to contribute to, showcase work, and find collaborators

sections.problem_statement: Indian developers struggle to discover high-impact open-source projects due to fragmented repositories and a lack of localized mentorship, leading to high abandonment rates in early-stage contributions. Existing global platforms like GitHub lack context-aware matching for Indian developers, failing to bridge the gap between academic intent and professional production-grade contribution. This platform uniquely solves this by using a localized skill-graph and collaboration matching engine to turn passive learners into active maintainers.
target_users: Aarav, 3rd-year CS student, Tier-2 college, struggling to build a professional GitHub portfolio that stands out to recruiters.
Priya, Backend Engineer, Early-stage startup, seeking to contribute to high-scale OSS but overwhelmed by 'Good First Issue' noise and lack of code-base context.
Vikram, OSS Maintainer, Deep-tech startup, struggling to find reliable, long-term contributors for his library who understand the specific domain requirements.
user_stories: As a student, I want to filter projects by 'Tech Stack + Difficulty Level' so that I can find tasks matching my current proficiency without feeling overwhelmed.
As a contributor, I want to link my GitHub Activity Graph to my profile so that I can showcase my consistent contribution history to Indian hiring managers.
As a maintainer, I want to tag issues with 'Mentorship Available' so that I can attract high-potential juniors who need guidance to become long-term contributors.
As a developer, I want to join region-specific collaboration pods so that I can solve complex bugs with peers in the same time zone.
As a user, I want to generate a 'Contribution Resume' that summarizes my impact across different repos so that I can improve my chances of getting shortlisted for jobs.
mvp_features: Smart Discovery Engine: Uses GitHub API v4 to scrape and categorize 'Good First Issues' by language, framework, and estimated time-to-resolve.
Contributor Portfolio: A unified dashboard aggregating commits, PRs, and code reviews into a developer-centric performance metric.
Mentorship Tags: A flagging system for maintainers to highlight issues that are suitable for first-time contributors with active guidance.
Collaboration Pods: A localized bulletin board for developers to form small, temporary teams for specific project milestones.
The 'OSS Impact' Resume: A downloadable PDF/Web-link that maps specific PRs to technical competencies relevant to the Indian job market.
Verified Identity Integration: Integration with LinkedIn/GitHub to ensure professional accountability, adhering to DPDP Act data minimization principles.
future_features: AI-Powered Code Reviewer: Automated feedback for PRs to reduce the burden on maintainers and improve code quality.
OSS Grant Marketplace: Facilitating micro-grants for contributors working on critical Indian digital public infrastructure projects.
Event Integration: Real-time sync with local hackathons and meetups to foster offline collaboration.
Company Spotlights: Sponsored project boards where companies highlight the OSS they use and hire contributors directly.
success_metrics: Monthly Active Contributors (MAC): 5,000 active contributors within 6 months — measures the platform's utility and stickiness.
First-PR Time-to-Merge: Average 48 hours for tagged 'Good First Issues' within 9 months — measures the effectiveness of the mentorship loop.
Retention Rate: 30% of contributors making a second PR within 3 months — indicates long-term engagement.
Maintainer Growth: 500+ active maintainer-led projects onboarded by year 1 — validates supply-side value.
assumptions: Indian developers are willing to contribute to OSS if the barrier to entry is lowered via mentorship.
GitHub remains the primary source of truth for developer activity in India.
Startups and SMEs are willing to sponsor or support OSS projects if they can identify talent early.
risks: Quality of contributions: Low-quality 'spam' PRs → Implement automated pre-check linting and community-led peer review scores.
Platform abandonment: Users stop contributing after securing a job → Gamify the 'Maintainer' path to encourage giving back.
Data Privacy: Compliance with the Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act → Store PII in India-based servers and implement strict data minimization.
sections.go_to_market: Launch via a targeted 'OSS Contribution Month' campaign across Tier-1 and Tier-2 engineering colleges in India. Partner with developer communities like DevIncept and local GDG chapters to build early supply. The first 100 users will be onboarded via a 'Founder's Circle' program, providing them with mentorship from senior engineers to ensure high-quality PRs.
sections.tech_stack_suggestion: Built on Next.js (App Router) for SEO, with a PostgreSQL backend hosted on AWS Mumbai region to ensure low latency and data residency compliance. Use the GitHub GraphQL API for real-time synchronization and Vercel for rapid deployment. Integrate Supabase for authentication and real-time collaboration features.
sections.monetisation: Freemium model: Free for individual contributors; 'Talent Portal' fee of ₹50,000/year for companies to access high-signal contributor profiles. Future expansion includes 'OSS Sponsorship' management where companies pay a commission to fund specific projects. This ensures alignment with developer growth while creating a sustainable B2B revenue stream from hiring needs.
